In the passing of a hallway, the boy walking to his destination was met with a sight. Two girls coming from the opposite side. The exact opposites. One running with a smile and purpose. Like a flower that is loved. While the other dabbling slowly, drenched, dripping water on the floor from where she walks. Both girls did not look at each other. As if they did not exist for each other. The one went across running. The boy did not look back. He could only see and be mesmerized by the feeling of pity that grew within him to see a sad spectacle that one does not see every day. The girl with her gaze down, short abruptly and untidy cut hair. A withering flower that lacked love from life. She too crossed the walking boy. This time the boy did tuen back. The ecstatic girl was nowhere to be seen, long gone probably. The only thing that loomed in the hallway was the back of a girl that could have been a blooming flower had she too was loved.

The day was marked by a new term year. For some it was their first day in high school after the ceremony. For some, they finally grew out of the label of freshmen and for some, the time was there to take the role of seniors and start thinking about their life seriously.

It was a classroom filled with students who finally grew out of the freshman role. Life would surely feel a little different was what many students thought to themselves. New encounters, new opportunities, new friends in new classes, yet among all this, there was a girl who knew nothing would change for her.

The time before the classes was marked by students all intermingling with themselves. The time during classes was marked with silence and hidden mischief. And it was the time after classes that students went on with their new found routines. To home, with friends, to clubs, or simply to hang out here and there or … to wait for the time you wished never came to you.

The door flung open as a group of loud girls stepped in. “Misakiiiiiii, there you are. Do you know how much we looked for you? We were worried you know!” one of the girls spoke with a loud uncaring tone. “Come on Hana chan, you could have at least informed us you know. Why do you think we shared our contact info with you?” Another girl added in meanly. “Its not like any of this lot would have talked or cared about you right?” referring to the rest of the class the third girl spoke of truth. While a fourth girl simply stood and enjoyed the spectacle.

The whole class surely felt weird with this sudden intrusion. It was not because they cared for Misaki Hana, they did not even remember her name during the introductions. It was forgotten just as they forgot the fact that a silent girl was sitting at the back of class. The whole class simply felt weird because their positive atmosphere was intruded in with people who ‘weren’t good’ and hosted negative intents. They were a loud pain which is considered bad compared to the more beautiful pain that is silent, to the extent that its forgotten that it still is a pain.

After some more loud ranting, the girls took Misaki Hana with them out of the class with them. With a moment of slice to comprehend what had happened, the class went back to normal. While Hana was being forced out, her eyes met with a girl’s. Someone who sat in the front at the far right side, total diagonal and opposite of where she herself sat. There was nothing special about that girl. It was a mere coincidence. That girl too had the same expression of pity and awkwardness like everyone else. Feelings that are clothed to cover the real body. The actual feelings of everyone’s heart. ‘helplessness and cowardice’. The day was marked over and this life of a girl who was bullied in this class was taken as fact. Everyone wanted to stay away from mess and trouble and hence that too became routine from the second day that would continue and so on.”

Things become very prominent when presented in a contrast. Show a life of a kid who goes to a club and has friends and lives in a normal family. Very average. But you show the same while showing a girl who is bullied, lives alone most of the time with no friends. The average turns into a happy route. Such became the atmosphere of this class. It was almost as if, good was feeding off of evil. Everyone in the classes sort of looked happier. Things became things to be grateful for. It was all that the girl, Misaki Hana would ever wish for right now. The average that was no longer average or normal.

With time, people did come and talk to her. Or at least tried to. But the gap due to that contrast was so widened, that it all felt too strained. Ended up becoming more of a burden for a flower that was already withering. If someone were to small a withering flower, it would only end is disappointment which hurts the soul of the flower even more. It dies.

Ever since the first day, Misaki felt rather connected to one girl though. The one she had her eye contact with. A girl that just looked special in her eyes. In this class, during time when she was not brooding of her life. She would observe her, and try to find happiness in her. A simple means of borrowing happiness when you have none for yourself. It is like enjoying a romance story and feeling good despite having no romance in your own life.

Her name was Kanako Ai. To Misaki she lived her life true to her meaning unlike herself. Ai was loved. And that is what it meant. She would talk to everyone in class, and was a liked person. Although she still did not come to talk to her. But she did not mind it, after all, had she been in the same position as Ai, would she have talked to someone like Hana. Probably NO, Misaki answered herself in the mind. That is why it was okay. It was a passable excuse.

Kanako Ai was a girl who had joined no clubs. She used to spend time with everyone in the classroom in a nice and friendly way. She had no particular best friend. She was a cute girl with decent length hair that she would tie in a pony. She was certainly not the most popular girl in the class but she had her charm and was probably the nice person. After classes, she would wait for this one boy who would come to the classroom door, and frantically she would run to go home with him together. They made a cute couple.

In the heart of Kanako Ai, she was an ordinary girl. She would strive to keep relationships good with everyone so she stays in touch in the social ladder. Her fears were to be left behind. Every day, she would wait for the classes to end for the boy who was an old friend of hers and recently now boyfriend. The only one she could feel safe, open and be happy. Asami Ken had a wild look with his opened top button and rolled up sleeves, ear piercing but actually was a very decent and kind person. He too had his own complexities which made him dress the way he did but he was a balanced person living life the way he did. He used to play soccer in the first year of high school but left club now as we wanted to focus more time to himself in other ways.

Ken was also a second year student aged 17, and studied in the class that was right besides Ai’s. Everyday both of them would walk home together. Ken dropping her home and then going to his home which was nearby. It was just like Misaki thought. They were a cute couple that suited.

Kanako was in a different section last year hence why she was trying her best to keep her place in this class. It is a struggle even for the normally happy perceived people. She knew the class representative was going to be chosen and she had full plans to nominate herself for this would mean a chance to interact with everyone.

Her life cycle went on, and eventually she did nominate herself to be chosen as the class representative. Misaki was happy for her. That day, Misaki’s mood was comparatively good. Kanako slowly did notice a warm feeling from that person towards her. She had to interact with everyone now that she was a class representative but she would always try to avoid her. Kanako Ai always felt a wall from Misaki Hana. It was a feeling that Misaki herself wanted to distance her from herself. As if two colors that should not be mixed. Kanako would feel pity for Misaki each time. Every day before leaving the class, she would see her sad Shallotte and wanted to do something but would fail to do so as if sensing that Misaki herself did not wanted to be saved anymore. It was if the flower dreams of going back to earth to reborn instead of just trying to revitalize.

Ken also told Ai many times not to interact with Misaki for it would bring her trouble. The girls that were targeting Misaki were a rowdy bunch with shady contacts and a bad reputation. They came from the same middle school as Misaki and something must have happened there. In his care, Ken always tried to counsel Kanako to stay away for her benefit but Kanako felt uneasy. Something was not right. She felt this bond to Misaki, a love hate type of feeling that made her want to do something yet at the same time stay away. The north and south poles that have a force between them but one that does not allow them to come close.

It was a day like any other. Misaki saw Kanako and Ken walking from the ground towards the school gate. Feeling happy for her Misaki sat there imagining how she would have loved to be like Kanako Ai, to be loved like that. It was during this hour, that Hinami, a girl from the group of girls that would bully her came in the class. Dropped some notebooks in front of her. “It’s todays homework. Do it by tomorrow. Because if you don’t, we will put actual frogs in your uniform in front of everyone in class.” Rudely passing the order and threat she took her leave. In an empty classroom with the evening light, Misaki Hana, looked at the notebooks that unlike a mirror failed to show her the tears that came in her eyes.

She took the notebooks, put it in her bag and walked in a tiring manner towards her home which felt like a long journey unlike Kanako’s who always complained to Ken how quickly they reached despite living farther from school compared to Misaki.

It was not the first time she was made to run errands like this for her. She gave the notebooks with homework done to one of her classmates and asked her to give it to Hinami san when she comes to the class because she still hadn’t come to school yet despite it almost being the time for the first class.

The was going normally until during recess when Hinami and her group barged into Kanako’s and Misaki’s classroom. They were fully angry. “You gave the notebook to Sayako in the morning?” She screamed in anger as she was asking the question that made it a bit confusing if she ever was asking it or simply stating. “She told the teacher that we made someone else do our homework and because of that the teacher punished us” She banged on Misaki’s table as she screamed what happened to her. The class was watching when one boy tried to step forward to stop this assaulting behavior but one of the girls from the group pointed a finger and told him to mind his own business. “Do you have any idea how it affected my reputation in class?” Hinami said. To this, even the dead flower Misaki couldn’t help but give out a smile, ‘reputation and Hinami’ haha. Hinami held Misaki by her blouse and slapped her which caused her to fall down.

Another girl seeing that this was crossing the line stepped forward and screamed at them to go away to she would call sensei. It was Aragawa san. A meek girl with small stature and hair but probably a heart bigger than the others to have taken the step. One of the girls stepped to her and said, “Go, I dare you if you don’t want your life to be as miserable as this useless shithead over there.” Pointing towards Misaki. Hinami took the pouch from the fourth girl that would always be standing silent behind and watching. She picked out frogs from there and opened Misaki’s shirt in front of everyone. Enough that her bra was showing. Obviously she resisted and the boys tried to meddle in but the other girls would step in between. Aragawa ran out to call the teachers but it was too late. Hinami put 3 frogs inside Misaki’s shirt. And closed the button roughly. And they laughed and ran out before teachers could come.

It was not the frog that was the problem. She opened her button and let the poor animal out. She closed her buttons but couldn’t close or hold back the pain that caused her to tear up. It was the humiliation and the same helplessness of others that she was so afar that no one could take the plunge for her. IF she was someone like Kanako, would no one have stepped for her in this situation? In dismay she went out of the classroom with her bag, deciding to leave school early today. Unaware of what happened at the site after that. If teachers came. If the other girls were punished. She did not care. She had no energy to care.

The next day, when she came to class. There was a moment of silence which was unusual. Today her presence was being personified, more negatively. The more she was trying to blend away, the more she was now highlighted as foreign. The feelings in Misaki’s head at that time were everything inhumanly. She took to her seat, looking down, averting to match her gaze with everyone. It was then that someone brought her chair and put it besides her table. Misaki gazed up. It was Aragawa san. “Teachers did come yesterday you know. They said they will take action. The whole testified for you.” Misaki put her head back in her arms as if to say she is not interested in this talk. “Why did you not consulted with any guardian or counselor before Misaki san?” she asked. Misaki turned to look at her in the eyes, for a very first time giving a determined look as if having a firm belief in what she was about to say. “Can a human, really change any other human? Will anyone be able to help me? Can they remove people who are only the cause of pain to someone else? Can they protect me when I can’t protect myself?” Misaki said in a voice that was loud enough for everyone to hear in the class. She put her head back down. She got no answer back from Aragawa but she did feel a warm pat at her head. The snuggling feeling of a human hand rubbing your rough hair, Misaki thought to herself, was such a wonderful feeling in its own. It was perhaps better than an answer. Because a gesture of softness is better than answer to an unanswerable question.

The latter half of the day went by normally. She was told that the girls had been suspended for a month from school. It wouldn’t change anything but in her heart Misaki still felt happy.

Kanako being a silent witness to this all had enough of it. She told herself she will break all walls if she has to. To get close to Misaki. All she lacks is a companion. Surely she can become on. She called upon ken that day on this topic while going home. To which Ken showed an unpleasant response. “Can we talk about it later. I would like to do so in a more peaceful environment and sitting somewhere in detail.” Ken spoke in a requesting tone to which they both decided to drop by at a café the next day.

The next day followed up. Aragawa once again came to Misaki san to talk to her. Kanako noticed it and wanted to do the same but had to wait. That day, Aragawa and Misaki had a candid talk. For once Misaki felt ‘watered’. She felt nice, and like a student. That was the first time, she felt like not relying on the happiness she had derived from watching Kanako.

“Who is your favorite person in class by the way Misaki san. Forgive me for asking such a rude question seeing your situation but you must have observed us all. You must like someone as a person at least?” Aragawa asked trying to strike up a conversation that could get Misaki more open to the class. Misaki did not mind the question at all. “Ai chan” she said. “Ai chan? Who is that?” Aragawa looked puzzled. “You know”, pointing silently in a hidden manner to Kanako’s table, and telling her, “The class rep. The one who has a boyfriend named Ken kun.” Aragawa gave a surprised look. “Oh, her. I see. Hmmm, interesting pick. May I ask why her.”

Misaki explained the first day, the eye contact. Her simplicity, and living a normal happy life, something she wanted for herself. “Basically, I look up to her because I wished I could be like that.” She concluded. Aragawa looked at Misaki as if wanting to give her a hug but they were not as close yet for her to take that step. The bell rang and she had to go back to her seat. “We will continue on this conversation later.” She smiled and waved.

The day went on with classes coming to an end. Aragawa had an errand to run in her club so she left early. She was in the handcrafts club. Misaki was a little hopeful for tomorrow. She was close to having friends again. Or at least a friend. She took to her way home. Walking with a little energy that day, a brimming excitement that was budding. It was not until she was half way home that she was Hinami and her friends waiting near her home. All that excitement suddenly turned into fear. They started walking with her, saying weird stuff that smelled of lies such as apologies and all. Misaki tried to free herself but she was still very underwhelmed. Her legs were shaking. The feeling of wanting to do something but knowing you cannot and will make it worse. The feeling where you see your life entering a dark tunnel knowing it has no end to make it out. All sort of thoughts filled Misaki’s head.

Hinami and her friends forced her to allow them to enter the house and eventually made way in. Misaki lived alone as her single mother used to work till late night and came home around midnight. Hinami’s friend opened the fridge and saw a bottle of juice which she poured in 5 glasses. The rest of the girls went to Misaki’s room. Where the first girl brought the juice. They served a glass to Misaki and everyone drank their juices. Shortly after which Misaki felt dizzy and passed out.

On the other hand, Kanako was sitting in a restaurant with Ken waiting for their order.

“Ai chan, tell me. Why are you overthinking about that girl so much?” Ken asked her. “I feel weird when I see her, I don’t know. I just want these feelings to go away.” Kanako felt her own answer to be rather shameful but it was the truth. “Look, she is being bullied. Even I can tell that, and she has sort of become the outcast in this grade. I just want you to stay away from her for your own good. It would be very troublesome if you got into some sort of misfortune due to her.” Ken spoke in a distressing voice. It was shocking for Kanako because she did not expect a kind guy like Ken to have said such a brute thing. He literally just asked Kanako to abandon someone just because it was troublesome. “I did not expect you of all people to say such a thing Ken.” “Look, Ai, I know this sounds cruel, but tell me, why are you doing this? Are you doing this because you feel sad for her? I don’t think so no. You are a good and sensitive girl and because of that, seeing yourself happy while someone else is facing misfortune like that makes you uncomfortable, and because of that you try to approach the situation in attempts of being good, but all you are doing is just simple pity and it is no better than looking down on someone who is more miserable than you.” Ken uttered the words, as if he was made to say things he did not want to, yet he did. And it just shocked Kanako even further that this was how he looked at her. Perhaps what Ken said holds true too. For Kanako too was a human and those thoughts did linger in her mind but she was left speechless hearing the person she considered her safe haven to suddenly have grown thorns. “Look Ai chan, this did hurt you I know. But isn’t this how you treated me as well when we first met. When I visited your house along with the rest of the class. Having known my family situation, isn’t that what brought you close to me? I felt bad when I saw you sort of pitying me, but then things changed and im very happy to be able to hold your hand today without any worries but Kanako Ai, im telling you, things with that girl won’t be simple like that.” He had held her hand saying all that. she pulled her hand back and asked, “So you want me to leave Misaki alone and be heartless just like everyone else?” “Look, it is too late for her. Do you think she was brought to this stage just because of the environment only? If you think that way, tell me, why is her and not everyone else or anyone else. I understand people are weak, but you have to see, she eventually accepted the role. She gave in, she found solace in isolation because she was too weak to face the music of the world. Do you think it is easy to make friends and then having to deal with their nitpicks? Do you think it is easy to be in a relationship? It might sound beautiful waiting for your lover in the rain but eventually down the months, the beauty of it goes down, it becomes a task. One that you do out of will and happiness, I won’t deny but nevertheless it is a duty, not everyone can stay in successful relationships. She herself chose to reject the world, so you think at this stage you can go in and talk to her unprepared and help her? Do you think you can? You will just make things more hard for her. Becoming a foreign existence for her in her own world. You are not ready. She is not ready. Don’t do something that hurts you. I worry about you. Please!” Ken said a lot of things, and with the way he was going, he probably had a lot to say more but hearing him say such cruel things about a person in pain and such a selfish attitude was something Kanako was not ready for. She could not hear any more so she just picked her bag up and left that place. He tried to stop her and come after her but since he had given the order over there he could not leave and hence Kanako went to her home alone that day.

Made to reflect on everything, she could not understand the weird attitude of Ken because she knew this was not the type of person he is. She saw how Aragawa san was trying to strike conversations and how it helped. Somehow it made Kanako even feel jealous of falling behind but she had enough. She would follow her heart from now on. Be more real. She saw potential in the whole class to help Misaki, but the times and trends have become so estranged that it is very difficult for the first step. Aragawa san having taken the first step, Kanako knew she had to follow suit and it would help Misaki in the long run. Everyone could live a happy life.

Misaki woke up, dizzy with a headache. She saw it was early morning and soon time to be school but she was not in the mood to go to school because of her hangover. She picked her phone up to see the exact time and saw notifications from Hinami on Line. Suddenly she was made to remember that they came to her house. But she had no memory of what happened afterwards. She woke up on her bed. She noticed she was even wearing her night dress. So why did she not remember. She opened those messages and saw what felt like the end of the earth and life to her.

It was her pictures. Nudes, in different poses. There was even a guy in some pictures doing illict stuff with her body. And after all those pictures, there was a single statement. “Your life, that never began is now officially over.” She put her phone on the bed. Not a single tear came to her eyes. She was officially feeling dead. Her brain could not process things further and hence why she just followed her muscle memory. Got ready for school and went onto her way.

Kanako when she came to class. She saw that Misaki had not reached yet. She sat on her table and saw a letter in it. Picking it up she saw it was from Ken, who was apologizing for yesterday and called her onto the rooftop during recess time.

Classes went on, Misaki still hadn’t come to class. Eventually the time for recess came. Kanako took to the roof where there was no one except Ken sitting beside a wall. Smiling at her when she came. While she was coming to his way he held his ears and apologized. Obviously Kanako forgive him to which they both sat, shoulder to shoulder. Talking about wholesome things to ward of the negativity.

It was during recess when Misaki came to the class. She opened the door and saw as almost many students were waiting for her, because as soon as she stepped in and closed the door of the classroom behind her, feeling empty, she was swarmed by a bunch of people. And a panicking Aragawa.

Ken and Kanako were enjoying their time when suddenly the door to the rooftop flung open. It scared them both for a moment but they saw it was Misaki. She did not see Kanako and Ken on the rooftop and simply went to the railing where she raised her leg to cross it.

Seeing that Kanako suddenly got up to ran after her and stop her from doing this foolishness. It was during this that suddenly Ken held her hand and stopped her. “DON’T, it’s her choice, she is just choosing the easy way out, even if it’s the wrong one. Don’t make her decision ruin your life. Don’t go.” He said in a very sad voice which made Ai feel very creepy of him because this was not normal behavior for any person. She was simply trying to go stop someone from making a foolish decision and here her own boyfriend was stopping her.

She resisted and freed her arm from him when he said, “Don’t go, otherwise you would not be able to come back.” It was not understandable what he meant but Kanako ran towards Misaki.

Love ran towards the flower that never received any. It was at this moment that Kanako looked back at Ken to see that he was not there, and Misaki turned and looked towards Ai, a love that was never there in her life. The rooftop was empty. She stood there at the edge of the rooftop. With memories of what happened today flooding her brain which had geared up due to the adrenaline.

“Do you have an imaginary friend” a boy asked her when she entered class today. She thought she would be branded a heretic due to her pictures being leaked but apparently that part of the story was yet to come. It had not happened yet. The problem she was suddenly run over with was totally new. “Our class rep’s name is Kurogawa. And who is Ken kun? There is no such boy with that name in the class besides us!” A girl spoke to Misaki. A third girl told Misaki, “Aragawa told us that you told her about someone named Kanako Ai being your favorite person. And you pointed to Kurogawa’s table. You are probably imagining it in your mind. She said we should carry on with this and while Kurogawa herself did not mind, I personally think with the other of my classmates that such things should be dealt to the face.”
“So ….there is no one named Kanako Ai” Misaki spoke. Aragawa stepped forward and held her hands while the others nodded affirming that her life had no love. “And you think I should have been dealt this directly to my face while no one else is dealing their own problems in life directly?” Everyone was surprised with that rhetorical question. Misaki Hana felt confident. People stopped scaring her. She made way and put down her bag and left out of the classroom. Aragawa tried to go after her but one of the girls stopped her saying give her some personal space to digest the facts.

And there stood Misaki Hana, on the rooftop in her personal space, digesting facts. Smiling to think, that living her life as Kanako Ai, living her life as love was not bad but she was an unloved flower that had finally withered away completely. And hence with the disappearance of Love, the flower fell to the ground.
